name: Mahmoud
headline: He builds SaaS platforms, payment engines and the web & mobile apps on top of them
bio: I'm a backend engineer and full-stack developer based in Cairo, Egypt. I build scalable web and mobile applications with Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js and React Native, backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and Firebase.
Most of my work is on SaaS platforms, REST APIs and financial systems: multi-tenant architectures, ACID transactions, background jobs and real-time features, shipped with clean, maintainable code.
I'm comfortable in Agile teams, I care about clean code practices, and I keep learning modern technologies. I also publish open-source npm packages such as egypt-natid.
contactText: I'm interested in freelance opportunities and full-time roles. If you have a question, a project in mind or just want to say hi, don't hesitate to contact me.
